div.head: Ine 31
div.ab: LXXV. Gif mon wíf bycge, ⁊ seo gift forð ne cume, agife ðæt feoh ⁊ forgilde ⁊ gebete ðam byrgean, swa his borhbryce sy.
LXXV. Gif mon wíf gebycgge, ⁊ sio gyft forð ne cume, agife þæt feoh ⁊ forgielde ⁊ gebete þam byrgean, swa his borgbryce sie.
Si quis emat (sibi) feminam et donum (pretiumque) non compleatur, reddat ipsam pecuniam et persoluat et emendet plegio, sicut borghbreche sit (erit infractio plegii sui).
{LXXV} Gif mon wíf gebyccge, ⁊ sio gyft forð ne cume, agife þæt feoh ⁊ forgielde ⁊ gebete þam byrgean swa his borgbryce sie.

If a man makes a contract for a wife, but the marriage does not take place, let [the bride’s guardian] return the bride-gift and compensate [the groom], and pay the guarantor [the price] for the breaking of his surety.

If anyone buys a wife and the marriage does not take place, he [the bride's guardian] shall return the bridal price and pay [the bridegroom] as much again, and he shall compensate the trustee of the marriage according to the amount he is entitled to for infraction of his surety.
If one buys a wife, and the marriage does not take place, the money is to be paid back, and as much again, and the surety is to receive compensation, as much as the breach of his surety cost.

Wenn man ein Weib [zur Ehe] kauft, die Braut-Übergabe [Trauung] jedoch nicht zu Stande kommt, gebe [der Braut-Vormund] das Geld [dem Bräutigam] zurück und bezahle [ihm] noch einmal so viel [zur Busse] und büsse dem [Verlobungs]bürgen so viel, wie der Bruch einer durch letzteren [geleisteten] Bürgschaft kostet.

If someone buys a woman [in marriage], but the handing-over of the bride [the wedding] does not take place, let [the bride’s guardian] give the money back [to the bridegroom] and pay [him] as much again [as compensation], and compensate the [betrothal-]surety as much as the breach of a surety [given] by the latter costs.
div.note: borgbryce; this term is often used to cover the same complex of rights as mundbryce. On mund, see p. 365.
